scripts.test: yarn test:core && yarn test:web && yarn test:ext
scripts.test:web: yarn feature:registry && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 vitest run --project @janhq/web-app
scripts.test:features:web: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 vitest run --project '@bibit/feature-*' && yarn test:feature-boundaries && yarn test:feature-fixtures && yarn test:feature-contracts
scripts.test:all: yarn feature:registry && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: yarn feature:registry && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:prepare: yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:tauri && yarn build --no-bundle
scripts.dev:tauri: yarn feature:registry && yarn build:tauri:plugin:api && yarn build:extensions && yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:tauri && cross-env IS_CLEAN=true AUTO_UPDATER_DISABLED=true tauri dev --features demo-runtime
scripts.build:tauri:linux: yarn feature:registry && yarn download:bin && NO_STRIP=1 ./src-tauri/build-utils/shim-linuxdeploy.sh yarn tauri build && ./src-tauri/build-utils/buildAppImage.sh
scripts.build:deb:linux: yarn feature:registry && yarn build:tauri:plugin:api && yarn build:extensions && yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:tauri && cross-env IS_CLEAN=true IS_TAURI=true IS_DEV=false AUTO_UPDATER_DISABLED=true TAURI_ENV_PLATFORM=linux tauri build --debug --bundles deb --features allow-unsigned-plugins
scripts.build:tauri: yarn feature:registry && yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:tauri && yarn build:tauri:linux
scripts.build:tauri:plugin:api: cd src-tauri/plugins && yarn install && cd ../.. && yarn build:tauri:plugin:api:linux
scripts.build:tauri:plugin:api:linux: cd src-tauri/plugins && yarn workspaces foreach -Apt run build
scripts.build:core: cd core && yarn build && yarn pack
scripts.build:web:linux: cross-env IS_TAURI=true IS_DEV=false TAURI_ENV_PLATFORM=linux yarn build:web && node scripts/verify-linux-window-controls.mjs web-app/dist
scripts.build:extensions: yarn workspace @janhq/core build && yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --include '@janhq/*-extension' run build
